item.title: Maiko Park: Under the Bridge, Over the Strait — Guide
item.description: Maiko Park occupies the narrow strip of Kobe shoreline directly beneath the Akashi Kaikyo Bridge, and it exists to let you get close to the thing. Its centrepiece is the Maiko Marine Promenade, a walkway built into the bridge structure that carries you 150 metres out over the water on a deck 47 metres up, with glass floor panels looking straight down at the churning tidal currents. In the same grounds stands the Ijokaku, a striking octagonal green villa built in 1915 for a Chinese merchant, along with pines, sea views and picnic lawns.
